nodes.label: Leather Armor Texture (Sheet 2 / Overlay)
nodes.description: Secondary leather armor UV-map sheet, likely the overlay/tint layer that allows dye color customization (Minecraft dye mechanic). Mostly flat near-white/transparent base so that a runtime color tint can be applied. Sparse pixel detail with a single thin horizontal stripe. Intended to composite on top of armor_leather to produce colored leather armor.
